getty:12a91807-8e45-4fa1-b6aa-f5979a6072.summary: A bronze bowl-shaped censer still hangs from a length of its twisted chain. Around its body are round medallions with busts in relief; the one turned to the front shows Christ with a cross-marked halo, between stylised plant ornaments. As incense smoke rose from it during the liturgy, the faces of Christ, the Virgin and the apostles circled the worshippers.
facts: The Getty describes four medallions: Christ, Saint Peter, the Virgin Mary and probably Saint Paul.
Three suspension loops survive, one only partly, with four and a half links of one length of twisted S-shaped chain; the censer is 10 cm high.
It was given to the Getty in 1979 by Lee Rizzuto.
